entries.en: So Mi, you OK? What's wrong?
entries.ro: So Mi, ești bine? Ce s-a întâmplat?

entries.en: The matrix, the-- the stadium… the Blackwall… Just lost control for a sec.
entries.ro: Matricea, stadionul... Blackwall-ul... Mi-am pierdut controlul o clipă.

entries.en: Reed! They're givin' us the slip!
